name: 243. Passthrough multipart uploads logged as form fields and parsed (passthrough parsed logs)
description: A multipart/form-data passthrough upload (audio transcription, image edit) used to log no request body at all, since only JSON bodies were captured. With content logging on, PreLLMHook now stores a summary instead: the text form fields as sent and only the name, type and size of each file part (passthroughparse.SummarizeMultipart; the file bytes are never stored, params.multipart_summary marks it), and the batch writer parses that summary into the typed row (transcription_input with the filename, transcription_output from the JSON response). Red before the change: passthrough_request_body is empty and params.parsed_type never appears.

item.name: 243.1 openai/whisper-1 /openai_passthrough/v1/audio/transcriptions multipart upload logged as a form summary and parsed (passthrough parsed logs)

exec: pm.test('openai transcription multipart parsed: upstream call succeeded', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200); });
var reqId = pm.response.headers.get('x-bifrost-request-id');
pm.test('openai transcription multipart parsed: x-bifrost-request-id echoed', function () { pm.expect(reqId, 'x-bifrost-request-id header').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
function checkLog(attempt) {
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('baseUrl') + '/api/logs/' + reqId, method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) {
var j = (!err && res.code === 200) ? res.json() : null;
if (j && j.params && j.params.parsed_type !== undefined) {
pm.test('openai transcription multipart parsed: parsed as transcription', function () { pm.expect(j.params.parsed_type, JSON.stringify(j.params)).to.eql('transcription'); });

pm.test('openai transcription multipart parsed: stored as transcription and tagged passthrough', function () { pm.expect(j.object, JSON.stringify(j)).to.eql('transcription'); pm.expect(j.is_passthrough, JSON.stringify(j)).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('openai transcription multipart parsed: body logged as a form summary', function () { pm.expect(j.params.multipart_summary, JSON.stringify(j.params)).to.eql(true); var s = JSON.parse(j.passthrough_request_body); pm.expect(s.fields.model, j.passthrough_request_body).to.eql('whisper-1'); pm.expect(s.files, j.passthrough_request_body).to.be.an('array').with.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(s.files[0].filename).to.eql('sample.mp3'); pm.expect(s.files[0].bytes).to.be.above(1000); });
pm.test('openai transcription multipart parsed: audio bytes not stored', function () { pm.expect(j.passthrough_request_body.length, 'summary length').to.be.below(2000); });

pm.test('openai transcription multipart parsed: transcription_input names the file', function () { pm.expect(j.transcription_input && j.transcription_input.filename, JSON.stringify(j)).to.eql('sample.mp3'); });

pm.test('openai transcription multipart parsed: transcription_output parsed from the response body', function () { pm.expect(j.transcription_output && j.transcription_output.text, JSON.stringify(j)).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
return;
if (attempt < 10) { setTimeout(function () { checkLog(attempt + 1); }, 1000); return; }

pm.test('openai transcription multipart parsed: log row carries parsed passthrough fields', function () { pm.expect.fail('log ' + reqId + ' has no params.parsed_type after 10 reads: ' + (err ? String(err) : (res.code + ' ' + res.text()))); });
checkLog(0);

item.name: 243.2 openai/gpt-image-1 /openai_passthrough/v1/images/edits multipart upload logged as a form summary and parsed (passthrough parsed logs)

var reqId = pm.response.headers.get('x-bifrost-request-id');

return;
if (attempt < 10) { setTimeout(function () { checkLog(attempt + 1); }, 1000); return; }

pm.test('openai image edit multipart parsed: log row carries parsed passthrough fields', function () { pm.expect.fail('log ' + reqId + ' has no params.parsed_type after 10 reads: ' + (err ? String(err) : (res.code + ' ' + res.text()))); });
checkLog(0);

item.name: 243.3 [EXPECT-4XX] openai/dall-e-2 /openai_passthrough/v1/images/variations multipart upload logged as a form summary and parsed though OpenAI retired the model (passthrough parsed logs)

exec: // Variations only ever served dall-e-2 and OpenAI has retired it, so the endpoint answers 404 for every model. The row is still typed, parsed and summarized from the request, which is what this case pins.
pm.test('openai image variation multipart parsed: OpenAI answers 404 for the retired dall-e-2, passed through', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(404); });
var reqId = pm.response.headers.get('x-bifrost-request-id');
pm.test('openai image variation multipart parsed: x-bifrost-request-id echoed', function () { pm.expect(reqId, 'x-bifrost-request-id header').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
function checkLog(attempt) {
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('baseUrl') + '/api/logs/' + reqId, method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) {
var j = (!err && res.code === 200) ? res.json() : null;
if (j && j.params && j.params.parsed_type !== undefined) {
pm.test('openai image variation multipart parsed: parsed as image variation', function () { pm.expect(j.params.parsed_type, JSON.stringify(j.params)).to.eql('image_variation'); });

pm.test('openai image variation multipart parsed: stored as image_variation and tagged passthrough', function () { pm.expect(j.object, JSON.stringify(j)).to.eql('image_variation'); pm.expect(j.is_passthrough, JSON.stringify(j)).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('openai image variation multipart parsed: params parsed from the form', function () { pm.expect(j.params.model_params && j.params.model_params.size, JSON.stringify(j.params)).to.eql('256x256'); });

pm.test('openai image variation multipart parsed: body logged as a form summary', function () { pm.expect(j.params.multipart_summary, JSON.stringify(j.params)).to.eql(true); var s = JSON.parse(j.passthrough_request_body); pm.expect(s.fields.model, j.passthrough_request_body).to.eql('dall-e-2'); var f = (s.files || []).filter(function (x) { return x.field === 'image'; }); pm.expect(f, j.passthrough_request_body).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(f[0].filename).to.eql('sample.png'); pm.expect(f[0].bytes).to.be.above(1000); });
pm.test('openai image variation multipart parsed: image bytes not stored', function () { pm.expect(j.passthrough_request_body.length, 'summary length').to.be.below(2000); });

pm.test('openai image variation multipart parsed: the upstream 404 is recorded on the row', function () { pm.expect(j.params.status_code, JSON.stringify(j.params)).to.eql(404); pm.expect(j.status, JSON.stringify(j)).to.eql('error'); });
return;
if (attempt < 10) { setTimeout(function () { checkLog(attempt + 1); }, 1000); return; }

pm.test('openai image variation multipart parsed: log row carries parsed passthrough fields', function () { pm.expect.fail('log ' + reqId + ' has no params.parsed_type after 10 reads: ' + (err ? String(err) : (res.code + ' ' + res.text()))); });
checkLog(0);
